description_zh: 本田 Civic（ego）在 Barneveld Avenue 直行接近三向停车标志路口时，未及时刹停，追尾撞上前方已停在路口等待的 Waymo AV（静止前车）。选取后车为 ego 以测试其能否及时避免追尾。

source_snippets: The Waymo AV was traveling north on Barneveld Avenue and came to a stop at the 3-way stop sign controlled intersection of Jerrold Avenue, when a passenger car approached the Waymo AV from behind. The front of the passenger car made contact with the rear of the Waymo AV.
VEHICLE 1: Stopped in Traffic; VEHICLE 2: Moving
evidence.reason: 后车主动移动追尾静止前车，场景可由 ego 直行、前车 stopped_ahead 表达。选取后车为 ego 以测试驾驶决策。
